summary: PLDT Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC attaching disclosure letters sent to the Philippine Stock Exchange and SEC regarding a cash dividend declaration on its Series IV Cumulative Non-Convertible Redeemable Preferred Stock. The dividend totals PHP 12,420,000 for the quarter ending June 15, 2026, payable on June 15, 2026, to holders of record as of May 21, 2026. The dividend was declared from audited unrestricted retained earnings as of December 31, 2025, which are sufficient to cover the amount. This is a regular preferred dividend payment, not a special event. Watch for no risk-arb angle as this is a routine capital return.
